entrypoints.fresh_RGB_API: from deploy_query_visibility import QueryVisibility; api=QueryVisibility(); result=api.predict_rgb(rgb_uint8_HWC, initial_points_8x2, saved_initial_pose=None); api.close()

optional_initial_pose.centroid: saved camera translation3; no fitting performed

input_contract.query_order: original native cuboid order 0..7; center point8 excluded; never permute by visibility
input_contract.x: 8,65,9,9 P3 frozen FP16-rounded + grid validity bit
input_contract.sam: 8,1,9,9 selected SAM normalized /8 clipped[-4,4] at native9 grid
input_contract.context: 64 or8,64; defaults to mean valid first64 feature cells across target8ROIs
input_contract.target_box: fresh mode always q8 minmax clipped, at least2 finite points and width/height>=2px

output_contract.p_visible_exact: learned frozen exact-nearest-pixel probability; .5 unchanged source threshold
output_contract.raw_SAM_center_logit: independent frozen selected mask exact point score; light cache reconstruction flagged clipped when full map absent
output_contract.nearby_r2_support: independent max rawSAM logit in clipped5x5 square, >0; without full SAM map UNKNOWN; never substitutes exact probability
output_contract.self_hidden_geometry_proxy: optional pure saved-cuboid geometry flag; UNKNOWN without valid saved pose; never changes learned/raw scores
output_contract.negative: absent_or_nonvisible at query; does not identify external vs self vs location error

limitations: pixel presence is distinct from semantic corner visibility
radius2 support is a distinct neighborhood target
geometry is a conditional cuboid proxy using unchanged saved pose
SAM ownership depends on quality of query-derived target box
RGB nearest-center and P3 continuous-query grid retain <=.5px per-axis phase difference by design
CPU and original CUDA P3 cells are numerically close, not bit-exact; source fixture records actual feature and final probability differences.
asset_integrity: DEPLOYMENT_BUNDLE.json binds source-selected checkpoint, source freeze, code, backbone and SAM vendor files; no threshold/model fitting in API
integration_rules: keep initial point coordinates and native ordering unchanged
reuse one API instance across frames and call close when done
freshRGB mode loads YOLO/MobileSAM lazily and never invokes PnP
use precomputedAPI to avoid heavyweight backbones; ensure caches match bound source recipe
source/private annotations and CAL parameters are neither accepted nor loaded
An existing imported MobileSAM package is accepted only when every pinned runtime file is byte-identical.
reproducible_test: model/smoke_deployment.py uses generated RGB and mockfeatures only; no evaluation data
asset_layout: deployment_assets contains copied SHA-bound selected head/freeze, YOLO26 weights+feature/ROI recipe, RGB recipe, pure geometry, and pinned MobileSAM package+weights. External dependencies are the recorded existing pallet-yolo26 environment.

portability.scope: local reproducibility in the current workspace
portability.relocation: Copy all bound assets and update manifest paths while preserving their hashes; recreate the recorded runtime separately.
